findings: Image syntax `[IMAGE: filename.png]` is not LinkedIn-compatible markdown. LinkedIn articles require images to be uploaded through the editor interface, not referenced via bracket notation. These markers must either be removed with a note in the publishing instructions, or clearly labeled as author insertion points, not actual article content.

Missing hashtags for LinkedIn discoverability. LinkedIn articles should include 3-5 relevant hashtags at the end (after the sign-off, before or after the credit section). Suggested hashtags based on content: #AI, #SoftwareEngineering, #AgenticAI, #DevOps, #Automation, #DesignSystems.
